messages.content:
다음 전략 선택지를 비교해줘: 원격·하이브리드 근무 정책 선택지
맥락: 팀은 유연성, 온보딩 품질, 제한 자료의 안전한 처리를 중시하며 사무 공간 예산은 고정돼 있다.
산출물: 장점과 위험, 되돌릴 수 있는 파일럿 추천을 포함한 세 정책 선택지
보안과 온보딩 위험을 명시하고 모든 역할에 같은 정책이 맞는다고 단정하지 않는다.
원격/하이브리드 정책 — 유연성·온보딩·제한 자료 보안, 사무실 예산 고정 — 장점·위험 있는 3안 + 되돌릴 파일럿.

Compare strategic options for remote and hybrid work policy options. Context: The team values flexibility, onboarding quality, and secure handling of restricted material; budget for office space is fixed. Deliver: three policy options with benefits, risks, and a reversible pilot recommendation. Make security and onboarding risks explicit; do not imply one policy fits every role.
Remote/hybrid policy — flexibility/onboarding/secure restricted material; office budget fixed — 3 options + benefits/risks + reversible pilot.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for remote and hybrid work policy options.
Make security and onboarding risks explicit; do not imply one policy fits every role.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about remote and hybrid work policy options.
Make security and onboarding risks explicit; do not imply one policy fits every role.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
